name: @miragon/pulse-c8-adapter
description: The Camunda 8 family's adapter of Pulse's runtime view (the Orchestration Cluster REST API, from 8.9 on, read-only), a plug of @miragon/pulse-c8-core's runtime: its wire on @miragon/pulse-http with client credentials behind c8-core's transport port, the words of its failures and its BPMN dialect. Bundled by the editor hosts.

scripts.golden:update: turbo run build --filter=@miragon/pulse-c8-adapter^... --output-logs=errors-only && GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 vitest run --project unit --coverage.enabled=false
